newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rosgosstrakh to ask auditor to reconsider.
newsitem.headline: Rosgosstrakh to ask auditor to reconsider.

text.p: Russia's biggest insurance company OAO Rosgosstrakh said on Wednesday it would ask the Audit Chamber to reconsider its report criticising conduct of the privatisation of the company.
Company president Vladislav Reznik said it would ask the chamber to take into account its views.
"We shall insist that the Audit Chamber looks through our notes," he told Reuters.
The independent Audit Chamber said last week it had found massive breaches of the law in Rosgosstrakh's privatisation and sent materials to the Prosecutor-General's Office.
It carried out the check on the order of the State Duma lower house of parliament and said the government had lost up to 198 billion roubles ($34.4 million) as a result of violations.
But Reznik said Rosgosstrakh would ask the Audit Chamber to include its comments in the chamber's report.
"The conclusions of the investigation do not correspond to the real state of affairs," he said.
